items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tonight Show Band? Let‘s see, Clark Terry… Jimmy Maxwell … I can‘t think of these other two guys... Doc Severinsen and Clark Terry… they were all real close and so they were the top men of the band

ctx.x: I‘m not, I know what you saying…Clark Terry, I didn‘t copy Clark and Clark didn‘t me, he got his own thing. Clark has one of the baddest sounds because I know it. Am I right?
